source_lifetime_witness.cause: RHS bank.get allocates before Python replaces the previous loop-local vector reference
source_lifetime_witness.scope: Python reference lifetime witness only; not a measured Task042 solver peak
source_lifetime_witness.script:
import json,weakref
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from src.solvers.lossless_vector_bank import consume
class LifetimeBank:
    header={'ntrace':12,'vectors':3}
    def __init__(self):self.refs=[];self.max_live=0;self.calls=[]
    def get(self,i):
        vector=np.ones(12,dtype=np.complex128)*(i+1)
        self.refs.append(weakref.ref(vector))
        count=sum(r() is not None for r in self.refs)
        self.max_live=max(self.max_live,count);self.calls.append(count)
        return vector
b=LifetimeBank();consume(b)
out={'actual_function':'src.solvers.lossless_vector_bank.consume','tiny_synthetic_shape':[3,12],'get_output_live_counts':b.calls,'maximum_simultaneous_decoded_vectors':b.max_live,'cause':'RHS bank.get allocates before Python replaces the previous loop-local vector reference','old_scientific_arrays_read':0,'FE_A_training_inference_Krylov':0,'scope':'Python reference lifetime witness only; not a measured Task042 solver peak'}
assert b.max_live==2
Path('/tmp/task042_review46_lifetime.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out))
source_lifetime_witness.implication: Strict one decoded vector contract not satisfied; published block workspace reserve may cover overlap, so no claim that total planning bytes necessarily underestimate RSS. Negative NN resident comparison remains sufficient.
